integrity: The proof separates the recent ownership source from older supporting literature, states the probability model explicitly, and makes no claim of independent or formal verification.
scientific_limitations: The zero-one obstruction uses the uniform distribution on unrestricted finite labelled Kripke frames and finite axiomatizability. It does not by itself settle the K4-stable cases, whose ambient random-frame class is transitive.
title: A zero-one obstruction to elementarity of finitely axiomatizable modal logics
